plan.title: Material PR to RFQ Split Award and PO

steps.note: Provide the required event title so the event can be published and found later.
Commit the supported 30-minute event duration before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors without inventing supplier names.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's bid at 100 through the vendor portal.
Verify that the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid at 90 through a separate vendor portal session.
Verify that the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Confirm the buyer sees both direct vendor responses.
Wait for the bidding window to end before ranking and awarding.
Open the buyer's comparison grid after bidding has closed.
Verify that the lower-priced Vendor B response ranks ahead of the higher-priced response.
Reach the awarding screen to inspect the available award allocation flow.
Assert that the awarding screen exposes the proposal creation control; exact split allocation cannot be expressed.
